moments.title: One video, one drop, three moments

one.title: You send
one.text: The Reel as published and the retention screenshot from Insights. If you like, what you thought would keep people watching.

two.title: You see the second and the line
two.text: Publishub transcribes the video, reads the curve in the screenshot and lines the two up. You get the exact second of the drop and the line you were saying — the cause, literally.

three.title: You get the rewrites
three.text: Three ways to say the same thing without losing whoever just arrived, each with the why. Re-record only that part and republish.

moments.sampleRewrite: On day 12 I almost quit. Here's what happened to my sleep.
moments.sampleWhy: Opens with a concrete moment and promises the payoff in the next line.

loop.title: A prediction you can check
loop.text1: Every "improve your hook" tip is impossible to verify. Publishub does it differently: it points at the second of the drop and bets on how much retention should rise after you re-record.
loop.text2: You republish, open Insights, paste the real number. It either held or it didn't. Over time you build an accuracy record and a log of what works in your niche — not everyone's.
loop.sampleVerdict: Confirmed — the real number landed 3 points above the prediction.

faq.title: Before you send the first video
faq.q1: What do I need to send?
faq.a1: Two things: the Reel's video file (MP4, MOV or WEBM, up to 50 MB) and a screenshot of the retention screen in Instagram Insights — the one with the chart dropping over the video.
faq.a2: Publishub needs a video with speech and a readable retention chart. TikTok shows that curve in its video analytics too; if the screenshot is clear, it works the same way.
faq.a3: No. It's a one-time payment with lifetime access — no monthly fee, no renewal.
